verses.en: We have sent it (the Qur’ān) down in the Night of Qadr.
And what may let you know what the Night of Qadr is?

verses.ar: لَيۡلَةُ الۡقَدۡرِ ࣢ۙ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ اَلۡفِ شَهۡرٍؕؔ‏
verses.en: The Night of Qadr is much better than one thousand months.

verses.ar: تَنَزَّلُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَالرُّوۡحُ فِيۡهَا بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ اَمۡرٍۙۛ‏
verses.en: The angels and the Spirit descend in it, with the leave of your Lord, along with every command.
Peace it is till the debut of dawn.
